holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank received a GST show-cause notice on September 30, 2026, demanding ₹229.14 crore along with interest and penalties.
Anup Bagchi resigned as MD and CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance effective October 13, 2026, with Sidharatha Mishra appointed as his successor.

expected.text: Nomura expects the bank to deliver 17% core PPOP growth in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest position at 9.52% of the portfolio. Its 3-month return of -3.30% resulted in an estimated -0.314% contribution to fund performance, reinforcing the fund's 34.5% exposure to Financials.

watch.text: Watch the outcome of the ₹229.14 crore GST tax notice proceedings.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The bank appointed Anup Bagchi as Managing Director and CEO for a three-year term beginning October 27, 2026.
Provisional figures for September 2026 showed gross advances of ₹33,075 billion and total deposits of ₹33,275 billion.
Foreign institutional investors trimmed their shareholding in the bank by 2.4% during the September 2026 quarter.

expected.text: Nomura forecasts 17% core PPOP growth across preferred private banks including HDFC Bank in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding an 8.03% portfolio weight, the stock was the fund's worst detractor over 3 months with a -14.27% return, causing an estimated -1.146% portfolio drag.

watch.text: Watch the leadership transition taking effect on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Bharti Airtel launched new postpaid plans bundled with free annual international roaming starting October 8, 2026.
Airtel Business unveiled IQ Gateway, a DPDP-compliant enterprise platform for multi-channel messaging and voice.
The Department of Telecommunications levied minor penalties totaling under ₹10 lakh for subscriber verification non-compliance.

expected.text: Morgan Stanley expects the new international roaming postpaid offering to arrest subscriber churn.

holdings.why_it_matters: Airtel represents 4.87% of the fund and detracted an estimated -0.292% over the last 3 months after falling 6.00%, shaping performance within the 14% Technology sleeve.

watch.text: Watch churn trends following the rollout of the new postpaid roaming plans.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: In a Q2 FY27 update, Bajaj Finance reported that its customer franchise expanded to 128.85 million while AUM climbed 26.5% year-on-year to ₹584,750 crore.
The company raised fixed deposit interest rates by up to 40 basis points following the RBI repo rate hike.
The board approved a capital raise comprising a QIP up to ₹11,700 crore and preferential warrants up to ₹5,800 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 4.87% of the fund, the stock dropped 5.93% over 3 months, compounding weakness across the fund's dominant Financials allocation.

watch.text: Watch the Q2 FY27 financial results board meeting scheduled for October 19, 2026.
Watch the execution and dilution impact of the proposed ₹17,500 crore total capital raise.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 overall vehicle sales reached 1,14,874 units alongside 50,208 tractor units, reflecting 16% sales growth and a 19% production increase.
Lightrock Group approached the Competition Commission of India for approval to purchase a stake in Mahindra Last Mile Mobility.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.99% fund weight, M&M's 10.65% decline over 3 months caused an estimated -0.425% return impact, making it the fund's second-biggest detractor.

watch.text: Watch regulatory approval from CCI regarding Lightrock's stake acquisition in the Last Mile Mobility unit.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: The CBIC clarified the application of a 5% GST rate across delivery and ride apps.
The company received an ESG score of 76.00 and entered the Leader band for FY2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 3.99% of the fund, Zomato gained 11.67% over 3 months to deliver an estimated +0.466% contribution, serving as the second-largest positive contributor.

watch.text: Watch the operational and consumer pricing impact of the clarified 5% GST rate implementation.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Reliance allotted ₹13,008.6 crore in 10-year unsecured non-convertible debentures at a 7.90% coupon.
CARE and CRISIL assigned AAA/Stable ratings to ₹67,000 crore worth of debentures.

expected.text: Europe's diesel shortage could lift Reliance's Q2 O2C segment earnings by 38% to ₹20,700 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.47% weighting, Reliance dropped 10.51% over 3 months, generating an estimated -0.365% drag on portfolio performance.

watch.text: Watch O2C segment earnings in Q2 results to see whether European diesel shortages lifted refining margins.
Watch progress on the planned Reliance Jio initial public offering.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T PT&D bagged multiple mega EPC power transmission and distribution orders across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and India.
L&T Energy CarbonLite received a limited notice to proceed for the 2x800 MW Chandrapura thermal power plant project in Jharkhand.
The company extended the target completion timeline for selling its stake in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad to December 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T accounts for 3.40% of the portfolio and anchors the fund's 8.3% Industrials allocation, falling 6.15% over the past 3 months.

watch.text: Watch the closure of the stake sale in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad ahead of the December 31, 2026 deadline.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional Q2 numbers showed gross advances reached ₹13,846 billion and total deposits stood at ₹14,521 billion as of September 30, 2026.
Senior managerial personnel Sanjeev Moghe tendered his resignation effective October 30, 2026.

expected.text: Citi and Goldman Sachs maintain bullish outlooks projecting over 32% upside driven by loan expansion and FCNR-B deposit inflows.

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank holds a 3.19% position in the fund, posting a -4.88% 3-month return while adding to the fund's concentrated 34.5% Financials exposure.

watch.text: Watch retail lending momentum following the departure of senior executive Sanjeev Moghe on October 30, 2026.

holdings.name: Titan Company Ltd

what_changed.text: In its Q2 FY27 update, Titan recorded 25% year-on-year consumer business growth and added 78 stores to reach a total network of 3,758 stores.
The company repaid ₹825 crore of commercial paper upon its maturity on October 8, 2026.

expected.text: Managing Director Ajoy Chawla expects jewellery sales growth to exceed 20% during the festive season.

seeing.text: Titan's Q2 jewellery growth missed certain brokerage estimates, sending the stock down over 4% on the update day despite overall 25% consumer business growth.

holdings.why_it_matters: Titan carries a 3.09% fund weight and experienced a sharp 1-month decline of 11.89%, influencing returns across the 15% Consumer Discretionary bucket.

watch.text: Watch whether festive season jewellery demand surpasses the 20% growth rate expected by management.

portfolio.statement: Axis Large Cap Fund holds 96% equity across large-cap leaders, with its performance weighed down by heavy exposures to Financials and automotive discretionary holdings.
interp: The fund's top 10 holdings form 48.4% of the portfolio, concentrating performance in major private lenders and index heavyweights.
Three-month returns of -4.92% reflect substantial drags from core holdings HDFC Bank, M&M, and Reliance Industries, which offset gains in Zomato and Divi's Laboratories.
portfolio.line: Heavy banking concentration and weakness in core mega caps offset health care and digital commerce gains.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank fell 14.27% over 3 months, generating an estimated -1.146% portfolio contribution amid foreign institutional selling and management changes.
M&M dropped 10.65% over 3 months, creating an estimated -0.425% drag on fund returns.
Zomato rose 11.67% over 3 months, adding an estimated +0.466% positive contribution to the fund.

themes.title: Private Banking Dominance
themes.text: The fund commits over 25% of its assets to leading private banks that are undergoing executive transitions and managing post-rate hike margin dynamics.

themes.title: Domestic Consumption and Mobility
themes.text: Exposure across automotive, lifestyle retail, and consumer services balances core defensive positions with discretionary demand.

macro.why: The central bank rate hike prompted retail lending rate adjustments and fixed deposit rate hikes among financial holdings.

priced_in.text: Slowing relative growth in Titan's jewellery segment was quickly penalized by markets following its Q2 operational update.
Foreign portfolio rebalancing out of HDFC Bank was reflected in a 2.4% stake reduction and year-to-date share price weakness.

could_change.title: CEO Succession Execution at HDFC Bank
could_change.text: Execution under incoming CEO Anup Bagchi starting October 27, 2026, could alter market sentiment regarding loan-deposit balance.

could_change.title: Festive Discretionary Demand
could_change.text: Jewellery and automotive retail demand exceeding management expectations during the festive quarter could reverse recent discretionary drawdowns.

portfolio.risk_note: With a 34.5% allocation to Financials and high concentration across ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, and Bajaj Finance, the fund remains vulnerable to banking sector margin pressures and foreign institutional outflows.
